4312.title: Branch protection hides waiting reasons
4312.rootCauseOneLine: Generic blocked attention wins over pending checks and reviews and maps to destructive styling.
4312.proposedFix: Define waiting-state precedence and automatic-merge presentation, then extend host and SDK contracts.
4312.caveats: Actual classification and display mappings reproduced twice; macOS rendering and live auto-merge were not exercised.
